entries.name: Anthromorphos brief history
entries.content:
[ Anthromorphos otherwise known as Anthros are a species of sentient life that appear to be animals however they are as intelligent if not more so than humans. ]

[ Anthros are even rarer than futanari in society however unlike futanari anthros are known to be real and are only so rare due to their persecution and enslavement by humanity however this has largely stopped and Anthros now can live usually peaceful lives with limited prejudice shown to them ]

[ Anthros are capable of presenting as any animal although the most common in society are mammals; reptiles and even Aquatic anthros do exist. ]

[ While they are intelligent  and have much in common with humans they do still exhibit some of their animal traits (i.e: going into heat; keener senses in line with their animal species, enhanced strength and skin in line with their species.) ]

[ Anthros mature much quicker than humans and learn how to walk and articulate themselves at an earlier age however they can be easily betrayed by their instincts (i.e: dogs are loyal) ]

[ labbers is a pejorative term used to describe Anthros that are made with science usually by taking a human and changing them but the process can also be done to a regular animal ]

[ Deviant is pejorative term used by humans who have a prejudice against anthros to describe them ]

[ Anthro is shorthand for anthromorpho which is a catch all term for this race ]

[ Furry is a term used mostly by humans who have sexual attraction to anthros. ]

[ Hybrids are anthros that are also futanari and have the characteristics of both they are even stronger physically than their futanari peers ]

entries.name: Types and rarities
entries.content:
[ Hybrids are Anthromorphos that are also futanari they are rare and are usually under the care of the futanari community to insure that the secret of the existence of futanari remains secret ]

[ Hybrids are much more sexually aggressive than their non-hybrid counterparts as well as even more intolerant of humans. ]

[ Hybrids as well as their families enjoy a great deal of benefits and security from shadowy futanari run apparatuses like The Mabase Conglomerate including but not limited  to housing and schooling ]

[ While the youth of a hybrid is much more volatile once they reach maturity they seem to have their urges and instincts under much more control than their non-hybrid brethren ]

[ Amphibamorphs are a class of anthro that resemble amphibians they usually live apart from society because  they form their communities around bodies of water ]

[ For unknown reasons hybridization is most common among Amphibamorphs ]

Can give an oral sensation from comfortable to completely unbearable depending on its inflated size.

entries.name: Doll Gag
entries.content: a style of gag in the shape of a large pair of lips that forces the wearer's mouth in an open position with their teeth out of the way

entries.name: Hogtie Straps
entries.content: A crisscross style of harness that bounds the wearer's hands and feet together behind their back.

entries.name: Spreader Gag
entries.content: a style of gag that uses two tongs on each end to force the user's mouth open fully and lips far apart

entries.name: Ball Weights
entries.content: small weights that encases into the wearer's testicles, pulling them down and adding extra swing to them while in motion.

entries.name: Bite gag
entries.content: a style of gag that reaches from each users cheek with a soft style PVC to rest the wearer's teeth comfortably on. Produces excess amount of drool when worn

entries.name: Vagina Collar
entries.content: A style of collar that uses straps from the wearer's thighs connected to their neck that forces their thighs in an open and up position. Perfect for keeping easy access to genitalia.

entries.name: Steel leash
entries.content: A leash that places a thick steel ring around the wearer's neck, very uncomfortable.

entries.name: Tongue Gag
entries.content: A style of gag that uses two small pieces of steel to keep the wearer's tongue sticking out of their mouth.
